sample_row_decisions.evidence_summary: The sampled release/database audit row is source-backed with the advertised caution preserved. Linked DBAASP assay row 77 records Lynronne-3, MIC 16, unit \u00b5g/ml, and Acinetobacter baumannii Q12-0809. Primary XML article-meta confirms DOI 10.1038/s41522-017-0042-1, PMID 29214045, and PMCID PMC5711939. Primary XML Identification of AMPs states Lynronne-3 as NRFTARFRRTPWRLCLQFRQ-NH2; the merged DBAASP sequence row stores the core NRFTARFRRTPWRLCLQFRQ only. Primary XML Table 1 row 23 has Q12-0809 / A. baumanii with L-3 value 16 under the peptides-and-comparator-antibiotics (\u00b5g/ml) header. Therefore the MIC value, unit, citation, and target are source-backed, while terminal amidation remains a real sequence/modification caution rather than clean source_verified.
cautions: C-terminal amidation is present in the primary XML sequence but not normalized in the linked DBAASP sequence core; keep status sequence_modified_not_normalized.
The source table uses the spelling A. baumanii; the release row normalizes the target to Acinetobacter baumannii Q12-0809 while preserving the source row locator.

The final activity_toxicity_evidence artifact contains a source-located MIC 16 row for table1-r23-c6-MIC, but its generated target class/species normalization is lossy; the sampled database-audit release row itself preserves the correct source target through source_activity_evidence.

material_limits: Packet material status remains extracted_with_gaps, but the known gaps concern figure-only exact toxicity values and do not block the sampled MIC/sequence/citation row.

layer_1_database.rationale: Database identity, citation, target, MIC value, and unit are source-backed; terminal amidation is intentionally preserved as sequence_modified_not_normalized.

layer_2_activity_toxicity.rationale: The sampled MIC row is source-backed by XML Table 1 and the database audit source_activity_evidence. The broader activity artifact has lossy target normalization for the matching Table 1 cell, so this is preserved as a caution rather than hidden.

layer_3_mechanism.rationale: The accepted mechanism artifact contains evidence_class values phenotypic_resistance_context and phenotypic_activity_context. The publication-grade ontology allows direct_mechanism, phenotype_supported, inferred_mechanism, computational_only, and unknown_or_not_tested; non-standard mechanism evidence classes in accepted outputs are a hard rework trigger.
